title: The Core Body Temperature Rhythms: Distinguishing MCS From UWS
brief_summary: In this study, the core body temperature of 7 disorders of consciousness ( DOC ) patients were measured every 2 hour for 168 h .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients in minimally conscious state
* patients with stable condition
* patients free of sedative drugs and Na+ or Ca++ blockers (e.g., carbamazepine) or NMDA receptor antagonist (e.g., dextromethorphan)

Exclusion Criteria:

* premorbid neurology antecedent
* patients in coma or vegetative state
* patients \< 1 months after the acute brain injury
study_population: The investigators chossen patients with UWS or MCS.The subjects include 4 UWS and 3 MCS.
